notes:
**The Telugu could say "crosses above" and could not say "drops below".** "rsi 30 kindaki vasthe konu" reached the parser untouched and was refused, while its mirror image "rsi 60 daatithe konu" had worked all along. Half a vocabulary is worse than none, because the half that works teaches you the rest does too. padithe, thaggithe, kindaki, perigithe and penchithe are all in now.

**Two of them were ideas, not words.** "kindaki vasthe" came out "below reaches", which is not a sentence. "paiki tirigithe" came out "up turns", so the Supertrend rule read "supertrend up" and left the verb in the amber box - refusing a rule it had already understood. Both are phrases now, with their opposites beside them.
